0=不做任何驗證；1=驗證伺服器（需先把受信任 CA 憑證放進模組 UFS）；2: 0 = no verification at all; 1 = verify the server (a trusted CA certificate must already be in the module's UFS); 2 = mutual server and client verification (a client cert and private key are also needed when the peer asks for them). Manual §4 is explicit: with seclevel 1 or 2 you must first upload a certificate with AT+QFUPL. ⚠ The old note here claimed "this tool cannot send a certificate so it always fails" — that was wrong. PEM is plain ASCII, and on 2026-08-07 the P5 run uploaded a 1939-byte ISRG Root X1 and passed verification. There is no upload button in the UI yet, so drive AT+QFUPL through its two-stage flow by hand. ⚠ Also note that sni defaults to 0: a server hosting several domains on one IP (badssl.com does) hands you a mismatched certificate when no SNI is sent, and verification fails with 566.
模組回 > 之後會「數滿指定長度的位元組」才送出。若長度算錯或中途取消，AT 口: After the module answers >, it sends only once it has counted the exact number of bytes you declared. If the length is wrong or you abandon it midway, the AT port stays in data mode and swallows everything you type next — send ESC (0x1B) with the raw-byte button on the Hardware page to get out; you do not have to close the connection or restart the module. The data really goes over the network and costs traffic.

末碼 0＝緩衝模式，資料要自己下 AT+QSSLRECV 讀: trailing 0 = buffer mode, you fetch the data yourself with AT+QSSLRECV
末碼 1＝直推模式，收到的資料由 +QSSLURC 連同內容直接吐出，不必再讀: trailing 1 = direct push, incoming data comes straight out in a +QSSLURC together with its content, no separate read
末碼 2＝透傳模式，AT 埠變成資料通道: trailing 2 = transparent mode, the AT port becomes the data channel
讀到 +QSSLRECV: 0 就代表緩衝空了，只有緩衝模式需要這條: reading +QSSLRECV: 0 means the buffer is empty; only buffer mode needs this command
